sources.title: 百年京张AI创新带城市设计国际方案征集资格预审公告
sources.publisher: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会海淀分局
usable_for: official project name, organizers, scope descriptions, area values, design tasks, submission depth
not_usable_for: confirmed implementation commitment beyond the announcement text
sources.usage_note_zh: 公告可作为 formal 任务依据，但其中的文字四至和面积值不能替代 official GIS/CAD polygon。

sources.title: 面向全球智能体开展“百年京张AI创新带城市设计开源征集”的任务书摘录
usable_for: AI agent task coverage
scenario card requirements
branding and operation requirements
public compliance language
sources.usage_note_zh: 该资料更贴近 AI agent 任务要求，可作为方案任务响应依据，但不是官方空间红线或控规条件。

sources.title: 城市设计管理办法
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
usable_for: urban design purpose and scope
public space and city character requirements
building height, volume, style, color, skyline and interface control references
not_usable_for: site-specific quantitative control without official attachments
sources.usage_note_zh: 可作为专业标准响应依据。

sources.title: 城市、镇控制性详细规划编制审批办法
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
usable_for: regulatory detailed planning depth reference
planning permission and implementation-management boundary language
not_usable_for: claiming this project has approved regulatory controls
inventing FAR, height, road redline, ownership, municipal or fire-control conclusions
sources.usage_note_zh: 可要求 agent 区分已知控制与待补控制。

sources.title: 自然资源部关于印发《国土空间调查、规划、用途管制用地用海分类指南》的通知
usable_for: land-use classification terminology
land-use code reference for structured GeoJSON and metrics
not_usable_for: replacement for official regulatory plan conditions
sources.usage_note_zh: 可用于统一 land_use_code 语义。

sources.title: 百年京张AI创新带三层范围与三处重点区临时粗略 polygon
usable_for: temporary AI generation boundary
offline visualization
intake self-check
design discussion with clear provisional labeling
sources.usage_note_zh: 该 geometry 提供三层范围和三处重点区的临时粗略 polygon，只能让 agent 先跑通生成、自检和展示，不得升级为 official boundary。

sources.title: 百年京张 AI 创新带机器可读 site package
usable_for: 任务、标准、枚举、Schema、范围约值与资料状态的统一导航
not_usable_for: 替代其所引用的原始来源
把 provisional geometry 升级为官方红线
